text:
maria_support: customer BrightField — says the org dashboard shows $500 promo credits but their API usage is still being charged. ticket #CS-9072. service key they used: sk_live_bf-01

raj_engineer: can you paste a sample request id / timestamp and which project the key is from? also which console org id they see the credits under?

maria_support: gave sample request id 2024-06-11T15:22:37Z req=01G9K2X, project id proj_bf_web, org id org_brightfield. they did a quick curl and showed 200 responses for completions but console billing still shows usage and no credit deduction.

maria_support: curl example they ran:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_bf-01" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-1","input":"hello"}'
```

billing-bot: credit-grant: applied promo "BF-ONBOARD" amount 500.00 USD to org org_brightfield on 2024-06-10T08:05:12Z (expires 2024-09-08).

oliver_billing: quick check — that grant line shows applied to the org-level billing account (org_brightfield). Are the customer's service keys definitely scoped to that same org? sometimes project migration creates keys tied to a legacy org.

maria_support: customer confirms proj_bf_web was created in 2022, migrated in 2024. their UI shows the credits under "BrightField (org_brightfield)". they pasted a screenshot of the key details page showing service key sk_live_bf-01 -> Project: proj_bf_web (Owner: BrightField Inc).

raj_engineer: reproducing locally. using sk_live_bf-01 I can hit completions and I see metering records under project proj_bf_web: meter_id=met_98765, usage tokens logged. However the billing ledger shows those tokens billed to project proj_bf_legacy (a different id).

raj_engineer: suspicion: project-to-billing-account mapping is stale. during the org merge a subset of projects kept legacy billing-account pointers. Console shows org credit (org_brightfield) but the runtime routing has the usage attributed to proj_bf_legacy which is not linked to org_brightfield credits.

sarah_cs: customer is worried about immediate charges. can we apply the $500 to the actual project as a stopgap? they requested an ETA for a fix.

oliver_billing: yes we can apply a manual credit to project proj_bf_web while engineering fixes the mapping. I'll need approval from finance for a manual allocation — pinging now. ETA ~ 24-48h for manual allocation once approved.

raj_engineer: root cause confirmed: missing row in project_billing_map for proj_bf_web -> org_brightfield. patch prepared to backfill mappings for migrated projects older than 2023-11. steps:
1) run backfill job to insert missing mapping entries for affected projects.
2) reconcile ledger: re-run attribution job to re-assign usage records from old proj_bf_legacy to proj_bf_web where appropriate.
3) trigger billing recalculation to apply org-level credits to those reattributed records.

raj_engineer: I've opened PR #2048 with the backfill + reconciliation job, queued for review. link: https://git.redwood-inference.com/r/redwood/infra/+/2048

maria_support: noted. Sarah — please message the customer: offering temporary project-level credit and we'll follow up after reconciliation. I'll include the manual credit request id once finance approves.

sarah_cs: messaging customer now. thanks Raj + Oliver. I'll update ticket CS-9072: promise manual credit in 48h and follow-up after reconciliation.

oliver_billing: finance approved manual allocation. creating project credit record now. manual_credit_id=mc_3382 allocated $500 to proj_bf_web.

billing-bot: manual-credit-created mc_3382 for project proj_bf_web amount 500.00 USD by oliver_billing at 2024-06-12T09:12:03Z

raj_engineer: once backfill runs we'll reprocess affected days. I set the job to only touch projects with >=1 mismatched record to avoid churn. PR merged, running in staging first.

maria_support: customer notified and appreciative. they asked whether this could happen again after future migrations.

raj_engineer: long term fix: added a check into the project migration flow to ensure project_billing_map entries mirror console assignment. also added an alert if an org has >$0 credits but a project under it has usage attributed elsewhere.

sarah_cs: closing loop in ticket after reconciliation. leaving thread open until final billing calc completes. :thumbsup:

maria_support: thanks team :heart:
